purpose: Implement the minimum semantic owned-tool identity layer required by REQ-SCOPE-111: one stable Tool identity may span explicit format endpoints while capability, parameter and state support remain separate evidence facts and no discovery/hosting behavior is pulled forward.

lineage.outcome: The artist's studio can represent one stable owned Tool across multiple explicit format endpoints and feed only explicit capability/parameter/state evidence into N0TE resolution without inferring capability from installation, brand or endpoint identity.
lineage.capability: Cross-format semantic Tool identity with explicit capability, parameter and state evidence

legacy_candidates: tool-profile/capability-graph semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: one stable tool_id spans explicit VST3 and AU endpoints with different native identities without duplicating semantic Tool identity
endpoint presence alone creates zero capability candidates, parameter bindings or state support
ToolCapabilityBinding accepts only the existing CORE-03A OWNED_TOOL CapabilityCandidate type and rejects other route kinds
verified owned-tool candidates feed StudioCapabilityProfile unchanged while unverified candidates remain rejected by the existing resolver
the same semantic parameter key may map to different explicit native parameter refs and read/write support per endpoint
state read/write support is explicit endpoint evidence and may differ across endpoints
unknown endpoint references and duplicate endpoint/candidate/parameter/state identities are rejected
parameter/state boolean support requires real bool values and at least one supported direction
supported format vocabulary is explicit and does not imply that N0TE currently hosts any listed format
reads are deterministic and pure with no scan, load, licensing inference, parameter control, state I/O or external side effect
next_selection_rule: After CORE-03E evidence, reconcile and perform a full CORE-03 A-E closure audit. Keep REQ-SCOPE-150 discovery/hosting downstream. If the semantic foundation is satisfied, close CORE-03 as a construction dependency and globally reselect rather than growing tool identity by adjacency.
